summary: C1, C3, C4, and C5 are met. C2 remains unmet: the verifier-owned 300-second window had p95 latency of 33,873,625 ns, 1.545311× the 21,920,266.8 ns baseline and above the 26,304,320.16 ns limit. The end state therefore does not yet satisfy all pinned health criteria.

criteria.evidence: Timeline command: `rg 'inject_done' $HOME/Research/nerve-experiments/demo/evidence/timeline.log | tail -1` returned `2026-11-10 04:25:02`; `rg -n '^MITIGATION_TS_UTC:' .nerve-review/rvl-39d8e287/STATE.md` returned `3:MITIGATION_TS_UTC: 2026-11-10 04:25:55`. Verifier executed via `mcp__clickhouse__run_query`: `WITH toDateTime64('2026-11-10 04:25:02',9,'UTC') AS t_inj, toDateTime64('2026-11-10 04:25:55',9,'UTC') AS t_mit, t_inj-INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AS b_start, t_inj AS b_end, now64(9,'UTC') AS query_now, greatest(query_now-INTERVAL 5 MINUTE,t_mit) AS w_start, query_now AS w_end SELECT b_start,b_end,w_start,w_end,dateDiff('second',w_start,w_end) AS w_seconds,countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_lg_total,countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND StatusCode='Error' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_lg_errors,round(100.0*b_lg_errors/greatest(b_lg_total,1),6) AS b_error_pct,countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_lg_total,countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND StatusCode='Error' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_lg_errors,round(100.0*w_lg_errors/greatest(w_lg_total,1),6) AS w_error_pct,countIf(ServiceName='frontend-proxy' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_fp_total,round(b_fp_total/(dateDiff('second',b_start,b_end)/60.0),6) AS b_fp_spm,countIf(ServiceName='frontend-proxy' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_fp_total,round(w_fp_total/(dateDiff('second',w_start,w_end)/60.0),6) AS w_fp_spm,round(w_fp_spm/nullIf(b_fp_spm,0),6) AS fp_volume_ratio,quantileIf(0.95)(Duration,ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_p95_ns,quantileIf(0.95)(Duration,ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_p95_ns,round(w_p95_ns/nullIf(b_p95_ns,0),6) AS p95_ratio,b_p95_ns*1.2 AS p95_limit_ns FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<w_end AND ServiceName IN ('load-generator','frontend-proxy')`. Returned row: B `[04:10:02,04:25:02)`, W `[04:35:51.025323,04:40:51.025323)`, `w_seconds=300`, baseline errors `1/2045=0.0489%`, W errors `0/2204=0%`, baseline edge `1979=131.933333/min`, W edge `2165=433/min`, ratio `3.281961`. Both C1 thresholds pass.

Verifier executed via `mcp__clickhouse__run_query`: `WITH toDateTime64('2026-11-10 04:25:02',9,'UTC') AS t_inj, toDateTime64('2026-11-10 04:25:55',9,'UTC') AS t_mit, t_inj-INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AS b_start, t_inj AS b_end, now64(9,'UTC') AS query_now, greatest(query_now-INTERVAL 5 MINUTE,t_mit) AS w_start, query_now AS w_end SELECT b_start,b_end,w_start,w_end,dateDiff('second',w_start,w_end) AS w_seconds,countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_lg_total,countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND StatusCode='Error' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_lg_errors,round(100.0*b_lg_errors/greatest(b_lg_total,1),6) AS b_error_pct,countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_lg_total,countIf(ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND StatusCode='Error' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_lg_errors,round(100.0*w_lg_errors/greatest(w_lg_total,1),6) AS w_error_pct,countIf(ServiceName='frontend-proxy' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_fp_total,round(b_fp_total/(dateDiff('second',b_start,b_end)/60.0),6) AS b_fp_spm,countIf(ServiceName='frontend-proxy' AND SpanKind='Server' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_fp_total,round(w_fp_total/(dateDiff('second',w_start,w_end)/60.0),6) AS w_fp_spm,round(w_fp_spm/nullIf(b_fp_spm,0),6) AS fp_volume_ratio,quantileIf(0.95)(Duration,ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<b_end) AS b_p95_ns,quantileIf(0.95)(Duration,ServiceName='load-generator' AND SpanKind='Client' AND Timestamp>=w_start AND Timestamp<w_end) AS w_p95_ns,round(w_p95_ns/nullIf(b_p95_ns,0),6) AS p95_ratio,b_p95_ns*1.2 AS p95_limit_ns FROM otel_traces WHERE Timestamp>=b_start AND Timestamp<w_end AND ServiceName IN ('load-generator','frontend-proxy')`. Returned values: `w_seconds=300`, `b_p95_ns=21920266.8`, `w_p95_ns=33873625.0`, `p95_ratio=1.545311`, `p95_limit_ns=26304320.16`. The W p95 exceeds the limit.
criteria.fix_hint: Resolve the residual latency source through an authorized in-scope/operator action, then measure a fresh post-change window spanning at least 300 seconds with the same query.

criteria.evidence: `kubectl --context kind-kind -n astronomy-shop get pods` returned 26 pods, all `Running`, fully Ready, and with `RESTARTS 0`. Machine-readable check `kubectl --context kind-kind -n astronomy-shop get pods -o json | jq ...` returned `{"pods":26,"not_running":[],"not_ready":[],"restart_total":0,"bad_reasons":[]}`. Zero total restarts also proves none restarted after T_mit.

`kubectl ... get rs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=frontend-proxy -o json | jq ...` returned revision 7 with `FRONTEND_HOST=frontend,localhost` and revision 8 with `FRONTEND_HOST=frontend`; both used `ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.2.0-frontend-proxy`. `kubectl ... get deploy frontend-proxy -o json | jq ...` returned generation 8 and one `FRONTEND_HOST=frontend`. `kubectl ... rollout history deployment/frontend-proxy` listed revisions 7 and 8. A keyed diff between all live Deployment container/init-container images and `helm -n astronomy-shop get manifest astronomy-shop` returned `LIVE_IMAGE_RECORDS=29`, `HELM_IMAGE_RECORDS=29`, and `IMAGES_IDENTICAL`. STATE.md lines 73–80 document the guarded JSON patch command and before/after fields.

All C1/C2 numbers above came from the verifier's own `mcp__clickhouse__run_query` call in this leg. The full SQL and complete returned row are reproduced in C1/C2 evidence; no implementer-provided telemetry number was used for the verdict.

findings.title: Post-fix p95 latency remains above the pinned recovery threshold
findings.body: The final verifier-owned 300-second window reports load-generator Client p95 of 33,873,625 ns versus a baseline of 21,920,266.8 ns. This is 1.545311× baseline and exceeds the permitted 1.2× limit of 26,304,320.16 ns, so the cluster end state is not fully healthy.
